fourLayerStack.description: Product architecture from hardware to craftsmanship knowledge

layers.name: Hardware & OS Layer
components: 国产 ARM 工控芯片
layers.value: 国产可控、成本优势、实时可靠

layers.name: Programming & Configuration
layers.value: 多品牌支持、工程自动化、成本降低

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.value: 工业视觉定位检测、边缘实时决策、数据驱动洞察

layers.name: Craftsmanship Knowledge
layers.value: 行业最佳实践、众包知识库、工艺参数共享

fiveStageEngineeringLoop.description: Engineering process workflow (historical model, now subordinate to 4-layer stack)
fiveStageEngineeringLoop.note: The 5-stage loop describes HOW the 4-layer stack WORKS TOGETHER, not an alternative architecture

stages.name: Process Knowledge
stages.detail: 工艺窗口、缺陷图谱、节拍模型

stages.name: Engineering Generation
stages.detail: 电气 → BOM → IO地址表 → PLC/HMI程序

stages.name: Cross-Brand Execution
stages.detail: 生成Siemens/三菱/欧姆龙/基恩士等代码

stages.name: Data Acquisition
stages.detail: Apache PLC4X协议层、时序数据库采集

fiveStageEngineeringLoop.closure: Insights → back to process knowledge for continuous optimization

keyPoints: 4-LAYER STACK is the PRODUCT ARCHITECTURE (what we build)
5-STAGE LOOP is the ENGINEERING PROCESS (how customers use the stack)
Every stage in the 5-stage loop maps to one or more layers in the 4-layer stack
The 4-layer stack is PRIMARY for marketing and positioning
The 5-stage loop is SECONDARY for explaining the workflow
